sources.title: LFM2.5 350M - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-350M is Liquid AI's compact 350M-parameter language model optimized for fast inference, tool use, data extraction, and structured outputs. It is designed to run across cloud GPUs, CPUs, and edge devices, and is positioned for lightweight agentic workflows and large-scale data processing rather than math, coding, or creative writing.
